title: Unit 17 Consolidation: Retelling What Was Said
goal: Review reported statements, questions and requests, time and place words in retelling and free indirect speech, and read a short text about Icaza and Huasipungo.
grammar: Review of reported speech in the past and free indirect speech

items: I can report statements, questions and requests after a past verb.
I can change time and place words when I retell what someone said.
I can spot free indirect speech in a short story.
I can read a short text about Jorge Icaza and his novel Huasipungo.
